summary.text: Luck Vibration Distance is an immortal killer move Ying Wu Xie named. He uses the vibration of his own luck to deduce how far he is from Fang Yuan.

claims.text: While speaking, Ying Wu Xie feels the luck on top of his head shaking intensely. Fang Yuan had elevated qi luck sensation so that even hiding inside an immortal aperture could not evade detection. Ying Wu Xie stops trying to conceal himself and his aura. He strengthens the luck sensation instead, reversing the connection: everyone has their luck connected, so if Fang Yuan can use that to find them, Ying Wu Xie can also work the other way. He researches a brand new Gu worm combination for this. Fang Yuan’s familiar face cannot be used against the method. Ying Wu Xie is a split soul of Spectral Soul. After replenishment inside the River of Time he does not lack attainment level, which lets him think of new Gu worm combinations when he has time to experiment and practice. Sensing Fang Yuan getting close, he orders the five Gu Immortals into the formation they had discussed.
